loop_design.title: K线增量补齐循环 (混合模式: 全量检查 + 单股实时)
loop_design.rationale: D1: 4 seams, 5 stages — 交易日历 → QuoteFetcher → KlineFiller+增量写入 → 全量补齐UI → 单股补齐UI, 每阶段产物独立可校验,失败模式不同

selection_log.justification: Runnable checks exist: (1) full batch: COUNT(DISTINCT code) WHERE date=today equals total stocks (excluding halted), (2) single stock: MAX(date) == today_trading_day, (3) QuoteFetcher unit tests with mock sources, (4) SQLite incremental write tests

4 seams: trading calendar → QuoteFetcher (network+normalization) → KlineFiller+incremental write → full batch UI → single stock UI. Each stage has independent verification and different failure modes.

S1:generate-validate (calendar utility), S2:generate-validate (QuoteFetcher with 3-source fallback), S3:generate-validate (KlineFiller+SQLite incremental write), S4:batch-process (full batch UI 288 stocks), S5:generate-validate (single stock UI + cache)

Inner iterations (unit test fixes) auto-retry; stage gates require human review before advancing. Financial data correctness is sensitive, and lifting the 'no network' constraint is architectural-level change.
5 stages strictly sequential (each depends on prior stable artifact). S4 internal batch processing is single-threaded on RN. S2 3-source fallback is serial, not parallel.
S1=3, S2=5, S3=5, S4=3, S5=3. Risk guards: INSERT OR REPLACE overwrite, first real network request, SQLiteProvider API changes, existing UI file modifications.
Financial data correctness > speed. Network/data layer is infrastructure — wrong poisons all downstream. Prefer thorough passes over quick半成品.

stages.name: 交易日历工具 (tradingCalendar)
stages.definition_of_done: tradingCalendar.ts implements isTradingDay(date), getLastTradingDay(date), getMissingTradingDays(startDate, endDate); 2026 holidays hardcoded; unit tests pass covering weekends, holidays, 调休上班日, edge cases

feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: 2026 春节/国庆等法定假日漏列导致 isTradingDay 返回 true,或调休上班的周六周日没标记为交易日
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: 测试只覆盖了周末判断,没覆盖调休上班日,也没覆盖 getLastTradingDay 在长假后的正确回退

stop_conditions.on_failure: 检查 2026 节假日表完整性,补充缺失测试用例,迭代不超过 3 次

stages.name: 三源行情拉取器 (QuoteFetcher)
stages.definition_of_done: QuoteFetcher.ts implements fetchKline(code, startDate, endDate) with 3-source fallback (Tencent → Sina → Eastmoney); returns normalized KlineDaily[] matching db schema; unit tests with mock fetch for all 3 sources + fallback scenarios

feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: 某源返回格式变更导致解析失败但没有正确降级到下一源,或归一化后字段单位不对 (如成交量手 vs 股)
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: mock 三源都返回固定硬编码数据,没测真实网络边界条件 (超时、空响应、停牌返回空数组)

stop_conditions.on_failure: 针对失败源调整解析逻辑,补充异常处理,迭代不超过 5 次;三源全失败则升级到人

risk_guards: 首次真实网络请求前需确认
修改归一化字段映射前需确认

stages.name: 补齐业务编排 + SQLite 增量写入 (KlineFiller + FillCache)
stages.definition_of_done: KlineFiller.ts orchestrates scanMissing + fetch + incremental write + logging; FillCache.ts LRU 30-stock cache; SQLiteProvider adds insertKlinesIncremental method; unit tests with mock fetcher + in-memory sqlite verify row count, data integrity, dedup, SQLITE_BUSY retry

feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: INSERT OR REPLACE 覆盖了旧数据但某些字段为 NULL,或写入后行数没增加 (重复数据未去重)
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: 只测了单只成功写入路径,没测批量写入部分失败场景,也没测 SQLITE_BUSY 重试和互斥锁 isFilling

stop_conditions.on_failure: 调整写入事务粒度,补充重试逻辑,迭代不超过 5 次;数据一致性问题则升级到人

risk_guards: INSERT OR REPLACE 覆盖已有 kline_daily 记录前需确认
修改 SQLiteProvider 公共接口前需确认

stages.name: 全量补齐 UI (概览页入口)
stages.definition_of_done: OverviewScreen adds 「补齐」button; progress bar with X/N completed, Y failed; summary dialog with success count, new klines count, failure list; ask user before recomputing all strategies; e2e on bigdemo 288 stocks completes in ≤ 8min with ≥ 95% success rate

feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: 进度条显示 100% 但实际有大量失败被静默跳过,或补齐后 db 中数据不对但 UI 不报错
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: e2e 只测了全成功场景,没测 50 只分批确认逻辑,也没测熔断后手动恢复

stop_conditions.on_failure: 优化批量写入性能,调整分批策略,迭代不超过 3 次;性能瓶颈需架构调整则升级到人

risk_guards: 修改现有 OverviewScreen 文件前需说明影响并确认
单次批量 > 50 只需分批确认

stages.name: 单股实时补齐 UI (详情页入口)
stages.definition_of_done: DetailScreen useFocusEffect triggers auto-fill for single stock; loading indicator; fills silently in background; refreshes chart + strategy score when done; LRU cache hit returns instantly; e2e: detail page opens and fills within 3s (with network); cache hit < 100ms

feedback_signal.falsifiable_when: UI 显示「已补齐」但 db 实际没写入,或补齐后策略没重算导致星级不更新
feedback_signal.passing_but_wrong: 只测了有缺失场景,没测无缺失场景 (当天已补齐后再打开应直接命中缓存)

stop_conditions.on_failure: 优化单股拉取+写入路径,排查 UI 刷新时序问题,迭代不超过 3 次

risk_guards: 修改现有 DetailScreen 文件前需说明影响并确认
useFocusEffect 触发逻辑变更前需确认

maker_checker.scope: Verify: (1) financial data correctness vs 3-source normalization, (2) no module boundary violation (network layer doesn't touch db/UI/strategy/indicator files), (3) backward compatibility of existing SQLiteProvider.importDatabase and 25 strategies, (4) INSERT OR REPLACE doesn't corrupt existing data

outer_stop_conditions.success: All 5 stages pass; full batch e2e on bigdemo 288 stocks in ≤ 8min with ≥ 95% success; single stock e2e fills within 3s; all unit tests green; 25 existing strategies still pass regression tests; db data integrity verified
outer_stop_conditions.on_all_failures: Produce stage-by-stage failure diagnosis with recommendations. If root cause is architectural (e.g. network layer needs native module), escalate to human for design review.
